// Generated by vmath ShaderHeader from the Java struct layouts. Do not edit.
#ifndef VMATH_ACCESSES
#define VMATH_ACCESSES

// std430, 32 bytes, alignment 16: color@0, width@16, flags@20
struct Style {
    vec4 color;
    float width;
    uint flags;
};

layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer styles_Block {
    Style styles[];
};

Style fetch_styles(int i) {
    return styles[i];
}

layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform table_Block {
    Style table[64];
};

Style fetch_table(int i) {
    return table[i];
}

layout(binding = 2) uniform usamplerBuffer texels_texels;

Style fetch_texels(int i) {
    uvec4 t0 = texelFetch(texels_texels, i * 2);
    uvec4 t1 = texelFetch(texels_texels, i * 2 + 1);
    Style r;
    r.color = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t0.x), uintBitsToFloat(t0.y), uintBitsToFloat(t0.z), uintBitsToFloat(t0.w));
    r.width = uintBitsToFloat(t1.x);
    r.flags = t1.y;
    return r;
}

layout(location = 4) in vec4 inst_color;
layout(location = 5) in float inst_width;
layout(location = 6) in uint inst_flags;

// the attributes hold the instance that is being drawn: the argument is not used
Style fetch_inst(int i) {
    Style r;
    r.color = inst_color;
    r.width = inst_width;
    r.flags = inst_flags;
    return r;
}

#endif // VMATH_ACCESSES
